caption: The drawing depicts two objects centered on a plain, off-white background. The object at the top is a cylindrical vessel with a slight outward flare at the rim, shown in light brown and greenish tones. It has engraved geometric designs, including circles and parallel lines, on its surface. The object below is a wide, shallow bowl or basin with a pronounced rim and a small spout or lip on one side, colored similarly in greenish-brown shades with reddish outlines. Both objects have a metallic or ceramic appearance and are rendered with visible shading to indicate their three-dimensional form. The artist's signature, "Carl Strehlau," is written in red near the bottom right of the lower object.
title: Pa. German Shaving Mug and Basin
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
